name: Tiny TR-CAP
description: A small-scale benchmark dataset for evaluating general-purpose image captioning models on image-to-text generation quality.
reputation: A small-scale image-captioning benchmark introduced in the literature; useful for quick evaluation but not widely adopted as a primary leader-board dataset.
notes: Very small dataset — risk of saturation and overfitting by modern captioning models; not suitable as a sole benchmark for generalization claims.
